## Figma Design (Dark Mode): SSR Guide — Docs Page

**Figma frame:** _SSR Guide — Docs Page_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-19 (cards, badges, and tags), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

SSR guidance page layout focusing on Next.js App Router usage patterns, caveats, and example snippets.

### What to design (in Figma)

- SSR guide heading, overview, and content hierarchy for App Router usage.
- Caution or caveat callouts alongside example snippets.
- Responsive documentation layout for long code and guidance blocks.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile SSR guide documentation frames.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Next.js App Router patterns, caveats, and examples have distinct hierarchy
- [ ] Code snippets and caveat callouts are visually differentiated
- [ ] Reading layout and long-content behavior follow UI-20 rules
- [ ] Uses UI-17 dark-mode tokens and UI-19 components where applicable
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
